title: Leader Attachment
description: Defines which character units can attach to which bodyguard units.

eligible_bodyguard_keywords.description: Optional keyword-based eligibility: any unit whose keyword set (keywords ∪ faction_keywords, case-insensitive) contains ALL of these is also an eligible bodyguard, in addition to eligible_bodyguard_ids. Models rules like an Inquisitor leading any IMPERIUM BATTLELINE INFANTRY unit.

conditional_groups.description: Attachment eligibility and role that apply only when their conditions hold: every required roster unit and no excluded roster unit is present, the required detachment is selected and the excluded one is not, and the leader and bodyguard share the required keyword.

required_detachment_id.description: The group applies only when the army has selected this detachment.

excluded_detachment_id.description: The group applies only when the army has not selected this detachment.

required_shared_keyword.description: The attachment holds only when both the leader and the bodyguard carry this keyword in the roster (e.g. the same Mark of Chaos).
